Both eyes now view one correctly projected surface. Distance changes where your eyes converge; width changes its size. These settings apply in immersive mode.

Using this on Quest

Start the camera, choose your effect, then enter immersive. Trigger: switch between water and clear. Grip: start or pause the slow cycle. With hands, pinch toggles water; start the cycle here before entering. Use the Quest system menu to exit.

The cycle smoothly explores four effects, taking 24 seconds between each. Pause to keep a favorite; moving any effect slider also pauses it.

This test shows one camera image on a flat virtual lens, not a depth-correct stereo view of the room. The image will not line up exactly with the surrounding passthrough. Camera images stay on your device.
